description.narrative: The Pacific Feminist Fund (PFF) is the first regional women's fund in the Pacific. PFF is the condiut for Pacific women's organizations to secure funding, to broaden the range of funders available, to represent and direct discussions within and outside the region, to amplify voices of organizations, women, and feminist movements in the region, to lead impact investing in women's rights and gender-based work, and to engage with Pacific leaders to support Pacific women and girls. Pacific Feminist Fund aims to increase grants and accompaniment support to women's organizations and networks in the region, implement participatory grantmaking and accompaniment, develop new knowledge and tools to support the resilience fo the Pacific women's movement, build strategic alliances, and contribute to providing more and better resources for the sustainability of feminist activism.
